description: What one riser band crop yields (T43, PLAN 7.3).

level_code.description: The level label printed in this band (e.g. '03', 'B2', '06M'), null when none is visible.

devices.description: Devices read from the image. Empty when the prompt already lists the band's devices.

id.description: A short id you assign (new-1, new-2, …).

label.description: The text printed at the symbol, verbatim.

model.description: The ETC model (PI1002, P-DOC-C-LR, UFMP8, ERP-FT-241P, EBDK, ERn4-RM, P-NSPS-DIN, P-TS7-E, UHCI-WM …).

name.description: A panel tag such as CT03LCPB, else null.

role.description: What the device is (T115, D201): an Echo relay panel, a Foundry panel, an EBDK, the rack or an ERn4 enclosure, an NSPS, a touchscreen, a station, a sensor, or other.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the band image.

cables.description: One entry per wire bubble (X, N, NG, F, P, UV). Unison U bubbles are chain links, not runs: leave them out.

bubble_id.description: The bubble id from the prompt, or a new id (new-b1, …) for a bubble the prompt did not list.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the band image.

from_device.description: The device id the wire starts at (the bubble sits on its line).

from_label.description: When from_device is null: the text at that end.

to_device.description: The device id at the other end when it is on this band.

to_label.description: Otherwise: the text at the far end, or 'Equipment rack' / 'Relay panel' / 'NSPS' with to_level_code when the line leaves the band through the trunk.

unlabelled_lines.description: One entry per line that connects to a device but carries no wire bubble: the last Unison link into an NSPS enclosure or the rack, a trunk marked only by a label at its end, a feed or note arrow (TO LOAD CKTS, 0-10V CONTROL, 120V feed). Never a line that has a bubble.

line_id.description: The line id from the prompt, or a new id (new-l1, …) for a line the prompt did not list.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the band image.

from_device.description: The device id the line leaves.

from_label.description: When from_device is null: the text at that end.

to_device.description: The device id at the other end when it is on this band.

to_label.description: Otherwise: the text at the far end, or 'Equipment rack' / 'Relay panel' / 'NSPS' with to_level_code when the line leaves the band through the trunk.

label.description: The text printed at or along the line, verbatim.

code_guess.description: Your best guess at the wire code, or null when you cannot tell. A reviewer decides; it is never written as the code.

notes.description: Anything the reviewer should know about this band.
